examples.title: [FIX] account_asset: To ensure the migration compatibility with 9.0
examples.body:
This fix allow to keep the same behavior of 8.0 and 10.0 to manage the assets.

In 9.0, the field account_income_recognition_id(oldname='account_expense_depreciation_id') has been deleted from the account.asset.category.form view with 6120babb4569cb846dacaae885cd2ba27f587d06 and
then it was not possible to manage the assets like in 8.0 and 10.0

But as this fix is in a stable version, it must be compatible with instances without any upgrade
of the view account.asset.category.form.

This issue has been solved in saas-11 with this commit: eb8d4aaa59562b41704c715202d0c794fd950a0b

examples.title: [FIX] l10n_it: Removing migration script that added taxes
examples.body:
As per commit dbea646d25c85b7196c583cfc5d9d2becefc9539 we added a migration script that was integrating base taxes with new ones.
Yet, the new ones require old taxes to be present, and the script doesn't check for their existence.
Since customers can always upgrade the module and reload the Chart Template, we decided for a removal of the upgrade script.

Reference: odoo/odoo#285586

Ticket [link](https://www.odoo.com/odoo/project.task/6518926)
opw-6518926

Forward-Port-Of: odoo/odoo#291805

examples.title: [GRAP][FIX] Stock migration for several inventory locations
[18.0][OU-ADD] account_reports: migration scripts
examples.body:
This adds migration support for renamed Profit and Loss XML IDs in account_reports.

Changes:
- account_financial_report_totalincome0
  -> account_financial_report_operating_income0
- account_financial_report_totalincome0_balance
  -> account_financial_report_operating_income0_balance

Without these XML-ID renames, existing Odoo 17 databases can fail during the
Odoo 18 module update with duplicate-key errors on:

- account_report_line_code_uniq
- account_report_expression_line_label_uniq

The migration preserves the existing account.report.line and
account.report.expression records and lets Odoo 18 update them in place.
